source_reports.citation: Painter, C.C., Heimann, D.C., and Lanning-Rush, J.L., 2017, Methods for estimating annual exceedance-probability streamflows for streams in Kansas based on data through water year 2015 (ver. 1.1, September 2017): U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report 2017-5063, 20 p.

notes: Painter, Heimann and Lanning-Rush, SIR 2017-5063 version 1.1, whose tables 7 and 8 replaced version 1.0's: region 1 on CONTDA and 1981-2010 precipitation (143 gages), region 2, the irrigation-affected west, on CONTDA alone (24 gages), both at 8 AEPs. The constant is printed, so intercept = log10 of it. SP (percent) and AVP from Tables 7 and 8; the report prints no covariance or model error variance. The report's precipitation code PRECIPRIS10 is NSS's PRECPRIS10. CONTDA ranges are the report's, 0.26-14,901 mi2 and 1.31-3,555 mi2, narrower than NSS's 0.17-15,000 and 1.02-14,600; the report's summary also prints 1.02 for region 2, against 1.31 in its abstract and Table 8, and the gages in Table 5 decide it. The report prints no precipitation range, so PRECPRIS10's, 15.39-47.0 in., is that of the region 1 gages in Table 5 (NSS serves 15.3-47). There is no worked example; tables 3 and 4's regression estimates reproduce from Table 5's characteristics.
